messages.content: List the 7 CRS sections and one line about each. Take your time.

The 7 CRS sections (locked, 46 modules total):

1. **Admin / Core (11)** — Tenant setup, users, roles, permissions, billing, Import & Export, Support Center — the platform backbone.
2. **Operations (9)** — Day-to-day floor running: Tasks, Break List, Malfunction Log, Meetings, Chain of Command Chart, Lost & Found.
3. **Surveillance (6)** — Monitoring and incidents: Investigation Cases, Alert Center, Vehicles, Gaming Day Report.
4. **Guests (6)** — Guest-facing records: Visitor Management, Guest Opportunist List, Blackbook Network.
5. **HR / Employees (9)** — Workforce: Onboarding, Job Board, Disciplinary Actions, Scheduling.
6. **Compliance (3)** — Regulatory: Policy Library, House Rules.
7. **Communication (2)** — Internal comms: Intercom, Info Board.

Section composition is locked as of 2026-04-28; `data/CRS_Module_OptionSets.xlsx` (mirrored in the Bubble Option Set) is authoritative for the full module list.
